questions.question: Simulate a cat falling on its feet.
Show me how a roller coaster loop keeps the cars on the track.
Let me play with a bouncing basketball and see how high it goes.
How does a rainbow form from sunlight and raindrops?
Let me cool a cup of tea and watch the temperature fall.
